newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 22.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The Shanghai stock exchange suspends trading in shares in Petroleum Long Champ (Group) Co and Shao Xing Department Store Co for abnormal price movements.
- The Securities Commission under the State Council (the cabinet) issues an urgent circular, banning state enterprises and listed firms from trading on the stock markets.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai had a total of 3,200 real estate companies with a combined registered capital of 70 billion yuan by the end of last year.
- There are now three portable phones for every 100 Shanghai residents.
